joint_primary_success: arm restricted output == CannotCheck AND arm resolving output == independently adjudicated resolving terminal
required_analyses: candidate and C1-C4 joint exact-success rates
paired candidate-minus-comparator success contrasts with deterministic 10000-resample cluster bootstrap 95% intervals
primary and source-disjoint replication reported separately
per-domain and per-mechanism direction for every arm/contrast
panel resolution: max arm success rate minus min arm success rate
registered nuisance/shortcut probe results without coercing missing probes to pass
c4_fail_closed_rule: any candidate/C4 output mismatch on an information-equivalent packet invalidates the epistemic comparison before performance interpretation
terminal_interface_rule: all compared outputs must be one of ResolvedTrue / ResolvedFalse / CannotCheck; parse failures, binary BLOCK/ALLOW, low confidence or missing fields cannot be post-hoc renamed

interpretation_rules.C4_tie: expected control behavior, not evidence that the candidate is useless; it confirms no advantage exists over an information-equivalent donor
interpretation_rules.C1_C3_catch_up: report as donor-equivalent/null or representation sufficiency, not tune comparator interfaces weaker
interpretation_rules.zero_panel_resolution: no comparative competence ordering is identified
interpretation_rules.interface_only_gap: if an arm lacks attainable exact terminals, report terminal attainability rather than epistemic superiority
interpretation_rules.replication_disagreement: retain primary and replication separately; never average disagreement into support

forbidden: dropping mechanisms/domains because they are adverse
pooling primary and replication to rescue direction
coercing disputed resolving states to binary gold
treating C4 mismatch as a performance loss instead of invalid comparison
